literal_meaning: হাত বিস্তার করা (to extend or spread the hand)
figurative_meaning_en: To become a petitioner or beg for something
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দরিদ্রতার কারণে রাস্তায় হাত পাতে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to poverty, he begs on the street.
If you need help, you have to ask for it.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali expressions of humility and need in social interactions.
